title: Natural terminal evaluation of sheaf cohomology on a chosen resolution
statement: Let C be a category in universe u with morphisms in universe v and Grothendieck topology J [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Assume sheafification for abelian groups in universe w [def-weil-pbc-sheafification], enough injectives, and HasExt in any universe z. Let T be terminal, F an abelian sheaf, R an injective resolution of F [def-sp-injective-resolutions], and q a natural number. There is an additive equivalence from Ext-defined Sheaf.H F (q+1), using the given HasExt instance, to degree-(q+1) homology of the complex R evaluated at T. For every endomorphism theta of F and every endomorphism phi of R commuting with the augmentations over theta, this equivalence carries Sheaf.H.map theta to the homology map of evaluated phi. The same equivalence works for all theta and phi.

source.place: Section 21.2, equation (21.2.0.1); Tag 06XR, Lemma 13.27.2, injective-resolution computation of Ext.

proof.text: For the constant sheaf Z of lifted integers, the constant-sheaf adjunction at T and evaluation at 1 give a natural additive equivalence Hom(Z,G) -> G(T). Lift G(T) to the universe of Hom(Z,G), and package these equivalences as b : preadditiveCoyoneda(Z) isomorphic to evaluation followed by ULift. Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right proves naturality.

Install the standard derived category and HasExt in the Hom universe, the latter via Mathlib hasExt_of_enoughInjectives. Reindex the original Ext groups by the composite of Ext.homAddEquiv and its inverse in the other Ext universe. The equality (r x).hom = x.hom, together with Ext.comp_hom and Ext.mk₀_hom, proves that this reindexing commutes with postcomposition. Use nonempty_extFunctor_iso_rightDerivedHom for Z to identify the reindexed Ext functor naturally with derived additive Hom.

Compute derived Hom on the specified resolution R using isoRightDerivedObj, apply homology to b.mapHomologicalComplex on R, and apply ShortComplex.mapHomologyIso for the exact group-lift functor. Lower the lifted homology group. Compose these maps to obtain e. For phi over theta, naturality of the Ext/derived-Hom isomorphism, isoRightDerivedObj_hom_naturality, naturality of b.mapHomologicalComplex after applying homology, and mapHomologyIso_hom_naturality give the required equation. Lower their composite equality. All comparisons precede theta and phi; zero objects and empty underlying sites require no additional assumptions.

proof_origin.place: Resolution computation combined with the library natural Ext/derived-Hom isomorphism and Mathlib homology naturality.

theorem exists_cohomology_resolution_evaluation_natural_succ
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
    [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{w}] [HasExt.{z} (Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{w})]
    [EnoughInjectives (Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{w})]
    (T : C) (hT : Limits.IsTerminal T) (F : Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{w})
    (R : InjectiveResolution F) (q : ℕ) :
    let E := sheafToPresheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{w} ⋙
      (evaluation Cᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{w}).obj (Opposite.op T)
    ∃ e : Sheaf.H F (q + 1) ≃+
        ((E.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).obj R.cocomplex).homology (q + 1),
      ∀ (θ : F ⟶ F) (φ : R.cocomplex ⟶ R.cocomplex)
        (_ : R.ι.f 0 ≫ φ.f 0 = θ ≫ R.ι.f 0) (x : Sheaf.H F (q + 1)),
        e (Sheaf.H.map.{z, w, v, u} θ (q + 1) x) =
          HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
            ((E.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).map φ) (q + 1) (e x)
